lines.text: The king gave Haman's estate to Esther and presented his signet ring to Mordecai.
Esther fell at the king's feet weeping and begged him to revoke Haman's scheme against the Jews.
The royal scribes recorded Mordecai's orders on the twenty-third day of the first month to 127 provinces.
Mordecai sent the letters by couriers on swift horses, setting the thirteenth day of the tenth month for the Jews.
Mordecai left the king in royal garments with a gold crown, and the Jews feasted with joy and gladness.
